name: derived-projection
body: The `apg/.trans/db.lbug` query index: a derived read model built from the scanned code graph plus the durable layers tree. It is authoritative for nothing — it may be lost, stale, or absent, and the next `apg scan` rebuilds it. Correctness of a mutation must not depend on it being fresh. Only operations that genuinely need it (queries, code-FQN resolution) should open it, and never in a way that makes the mutation path contend on it.
